linked_prs.title: 🐛 Fix Negative Token Sizing
linked_prs.body: fixes #878 - Was able to reporduce the issue by having a very small max token number. We now ensure that there is a minimum of 200 tokens as prompt return space.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue references an OpenAI error related to the 'max_tokens' parameter, which is a configuration for LLM provider usage. This falls under "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" and "Token usage misconfiguration" in the agent issue taxonomy.
